articles.title: Algorand unveils roadmap to achieve quantum resistance by 2028
articles.snippet: The announcement reflects a crypto's growing recognition that adopting quantum-resistant cryptography could take years, requiring changes not only to user wallets but also to core protocol infrastructure.

articles.title: Algorand Plans to Be Ready for Quantum Computing Threat by End of 2027
articles.snippet: Quantum computing threatens the blockchain ecosystem, from Bitcoin to Ethereum and beyond, and Algorand has a plan to be prepared.
